value.data: Marathahalli metro station (Blue Line Phase 2A) is under construction and expected to open by June 2026 or December 2026. The nearest operational metro stations are Seetharamapalya (2.61 km) and Kundalahalli (2.66 km) on the Purple Line.

Marathahalli is notorious for heavy traffic congestion and frequent jams, especially during peak hours around the Marathahalli Bridge, with commutes often exceeding 30 minutes. Metro construction work further narrows roads, contributing to the congestion.

The major upcoming infrastructure project is the Marathahalli metro station on the Blue Line (Phase 2A), slated for completion by June or December 2026, which aims to significantly reduce traffic congestion. Ongoing infrastructure improvements also include road widening.

Marathahalli is a popular and strategically located residential area in Bangalore, offering excellent connectivity to major IT hubs and a wide range of amenities including schools, hospitals, and shopping centers. However, residents frequently face challenges with heavy traffic congestion and occasional waterlogging during monsoon seasons.

A bustling and dynamic IT hub with a vibrant culture, diverse shopping options, and a lively atmosphere, attracting a mix of IT professionals and families, though some areas can feel chaotic due to traffic and development.

Marathahalli experiences occasional monsoon flooding and severe waterlogging incidents. In August 2024, the basement of Sonesta Silver Oak Apartments was completely flooded, and a wall collapsed due to heavy rains.
